message: No detected input validation: User inputs (model_id, feature_id, choice) are cast directly with int() and used without bounds/type validation beyond a single loose check (choice > len), and data loaded from files has no schema, dtype, or range assertions.

No detected untrusted source handling: Although smart_open is imported (suggesting possible remote data access), no checksum verification, authentication, signed URL, or pinned revision is performed anywhere in the visible code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the data preparation code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code instantiates models (SVM, RF, AutoEncoder, DNN, etc.) and loads features/data, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading any pretrained weights or serialized model artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: The code uses `upsample` for class balancing but there is no explicit check or assertion on label distribution or expected label set before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation of a held-out test set from training data, no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation; train/dev splits are combined in cross-validation folds without such protections.

No detected input sanitization: User inputs (model_id, feature_id, choice) are taken directly via int(input(...)) with no range, type, or bounds validation before being used to index lists or dispatch functions.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for NaN, out-of-range probabilities, or any other sanity bounds before returning or using results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML models (SVM, RF, DNN) and audio/visual/text embeddings, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
